people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.
translations.bsb: Do not think that I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, in whom you have put your hope.
translations.kjv: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.
translations.asv: Think not that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, on whom ye have set your hope.
